ARTHUR VANCE

The Guardian
Northwood High School PARAPROFESSIONAL AIDE

The Clinical Anchor at School

While Sarah Miller serves as Matt's primary Private Duty Nurse and ultimate clinical protector, she cannot always be present inside the classroom. In her absence, Arthur Vance is the anchor.

A retired male paraprofessional, "Mr. Vance" quietly and efficiently manages Matt's complex medical and physical needs throughout the school day. He is deeply lovable and genuinely good to the kids, operating with a warm, grandfatherly presence that masks an incredibly sharp awareness of his environment.

He is the primary reason the "School Matt" illusion existed for Courtney Evans—Mr. Vance absorbed and handled the intense clinical requirements so seamlessly that Matt was able to safely exist in the high school bubble, shielding him from the isolating realities of the Northwood architecture.

The Protective Instinct

Mr. Vance is not just an aide; he is fiercely protective of Matt's physical and emotional boundaries.

When Courtney Evans attempted to corner Matt with an inappropriate apology following the Omni-Q betrayal, Matt fiercely rejected her. Recognizing the immediate threat to Matt's autonomy and safety, Mr. Vance did not hesitate. He physically stepped in, using his own body to form an immovable wall and completely blocking Courtney's access to Matt's wheelchair, demonstrating his absolute loyalty to Matt's well-being.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.
